item.title: 'Hard to watch': Car slams into Florida school bus, becomes wedged underneath
item.description: A video posted by the Lee County Sheriff's Office shows a car as it slammed into the rear of a school bus on Wednesday, becoming wedged underneath it.

item.title: ALEA identifies man injured in officer-involved shooting in Albertville
